description: the witness's exemplar coupling, which round-2 evaluation showed unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 99a composition keyed its action-incidence branches on five derived flags defined as equality with out-of-chapter HTS statistical reporting numbers (a ferroalloy, an aluminum wire line, a football line, a beer line, a PV cell line), grounding chapter 99a duty outcomes on provisions that cannot describe a chapter 99a entry.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 96; diff is the summary hunk (generator bump plus the caller-input sentence) and the identical 100-line removal of entry_is_line_a..e — after stripping the chapter-specific redundant parentheses the removal block is byte-identical to index 96 except that this chapter instance serializes version windows with the `from:` alias instead of `effective_from:` (a placement-gate distinctness device, not a date change; the date '2026-02-15' is identical). Verified the imported line table us/policies/usitc/us-tariff-duty/lines/generated/ch99a.yaml at this commit covers 9901/9902 lines only and contains none of the five exemplar numbers, so the removed flags were constant false here too. Same doubts as index 96: generated composition, empty commit body, summary retains the 'runtime semantics are unchanged' boilerplate, consuming formulas untouched in this commit, and the §122 decoupling plus section_232_steel_component_rate promised in the PR body arrive in later PR #1300 commits. This chapter's summary also keeps its separate note that ch99a_column2_rate is intentionally omitted — unrelated to this change and unchanged.
triage.verifier_justification: This commit's ch99a diff does exactly two things: it rewrites the module summary and deletes the five derived rules `entry_is_line_a..e` (each a faithful `hts_number == "<line>"` equality with its own cited statistical reporting number), turning the identifiers into caller inputs under the referenced-implies-input convention. It does not touch a single consuming formula, so the coupling the first reader's quote calls unlawful survives the commit verbatim in the post file — `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0 else: temporary_import_surcharge_rate` (post lines 2576, 3043, 3201) and the per-line §301 stack (post lines 2998-3002) are byte-identical, and the §122 gating on `entry_is_section_122_exempt` / `entry_is_section_232_covered` that the PR body credits with the fix is in a different commit of PR #1300. A further refutation of "the fix removes the out-of-chapter grounding": an identically shaped exemplar binding remains, `entry_is_energy_resource` (source: "HTS 9903.01.13 energy and critical minerals article scope") is still encoded as `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"` in the post file (line 1955); pre had 6 such equalities, post has 1. The change is real in scope terms (five outputs removed, five caller inputs added, so it is not mechanical), but whether it corrects encoded meaning or merely relocates the flag determination to entry preparation as a precondition for the later repair is not settled by this diff or by the bare commit subject.
triage.verifier_quote: The identifiers entry_is_line_a, entry_is_line_b, entry_is_line_c, entry_is_line_d, and entry_is_line_e are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification.
triage.verifier_notes: Refutation basis, all from the pinned blobs: post = `git -C /Users/maxghenis/TheAxiomFoundation/rulespec-us show 2a6bdb01de:us/policies/cbp/us-tariff-schedule/generated/ch99a/ch99a.yaml`, pre = same at 956a5474. (1) The quoted PR justification ("unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines") describes the §122 component decoupling, which is NOT in this commit for ch99a — `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0 / else: temporary_import_surcharge_rate` is still present post-commit at lines 2576, 3043, 3201. (2) The removed rules were each internally source-faithful (formula matched its own cited HTS statistical reporting number); the wrongness lives in the consuming rules, e.g. `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` is still `formula: entry_is_line_a` (post ~line 1911) and `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still `formula: entry_is_line_b` (~1928). (3) `entry_is_energy_resource`, sourced to 9903.01.13 critical-minerals scope, still reads `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"` (post line 1955) — the exact wrong-provision pattern the candidate kind alleges was removed. (4) Not mechanical: five rule outputs deleted and five new required caller inputs created (PR ledger: −500 removed exemplar-flag outputs over 100 chapters). (5) ch99a received no steel component in this commit (pre 3476 → post 3376 lines, the delta is exactly the five removed rules), so the PR's steel-grounding evidence does not apply here. If the corpus wants the real fidelity defect from this PR, screen the later commit that rewrites `section_122_component_rate` to gate on `entry_is_section_122_exempt` / `entry_is_section_232_covered`; this commit is best read as the decoupling precondition, and the kind (untraceable_branch) would be the right one only if a reviewer accepts "deleting a wrong-provision binding from inside the module" as the correction.
